summary: Verified iteration-3 features (Image Viewer, Medical Reports upload, PDF anchor fix) across backend and frontend. Backend: /api/reports/risk-pdf?auth=, /api/images/upload, /api/images, /api/images/{id}/download?auth=, /api/documents/upload, /api/documents, /api/documents/{id}/download?auth= all return 200 with correct content-types (application/pdf, image/png). RBAC verified: another patient hitting /api/documents/{id}/download?auth=<other> returns 403; list endpoint scopes to owner. Frontend patient dashboard: Download PDF button fires a browser download event (risk-report-Jane_T1.pdf) — MEDIUM iteration-2 anchor-append bug is FIXED. ImageViewer renders X-Ray thumbnails (data-testid=image-thumb-*), thumbnail click opens data-testid=image-modal with data-testid=image-download-link, closes via data-testid=image-modal-close. MedicalReports panel accepts PDF via data-testid=report-upload-form and shows data-testid=report-row-* rows with data-testid=report-download-* links. Doctor detail view (Jane T1) also renders image-viewer, medical-reports, doctor-download-pdf-btn, thumbs and report-rows; doctor image modal opens successfully with a Download link. Test credentials file listed jane@test.com / Passw0rd which does NOT match request (NewPass123) — neither worked; registered a fresh patient (jane_t1@test.com / NewPass123) to run tests.
